Add a scene-initialization regression test to prevent recurring startup failures.
Show the actual 3D loading error in the browser if another failure occurs.
Hide controller and hand pointing rays during Reach unless aiming at an interactive menu.
Keep a draggable, legible challenge control panel on the left, outside the reaching corridor.
Gently dim scenery and idle UI during Reach while keeping exercise targets bright.
Displayed the active version in small digits beside the Solvi XR logo.
Added a scrollable [dev] release overlay, newest changes first, with show/hide control.

Added tested local staging, guarded SSH deployment, public HTTPS checks and backup rollback.
Preserved the existing WebXR lobby, Solvi model, teleportation and controller/hand interactions.
